title: Autofahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Polizeibeamter verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A 19-year-old driver fled a traffic check in Mariendorf, driving into bushes and a parked car and accelerating while an officer stood on the bonnet. The officer was injured in a fall and the driver was later found at a hospital; he had no valid driving licence.
